pages.title: Stress and withering
pages.text: A crop in impossible conditions builds up stress. Each successful growth reduces it. At 4 stress, it withers: it no longer grows and must be replaced.

pages.title: Mildew and rust
pages.text: Mildew (grey-white) hits tomato, cucumber, strawberry, lettuce, bell pepper, eggplant and potato. Rust (orange) hits barley, corn, soybean and wheat. Saturated soil, heat, rain, monoculture and crowded crops favor disease.

pages.title: Effects of disease
pages.text: A sick crop grows at 30 % of normal speed and yields half. It spreads to identical neighbors with a 10 % chance per attempt. After six attempts while sick, it withers.

pages.title: Fungicide and sprayer
pages.text: Fungicide (2 units): copper, a water bottle and bone meal. Right-click the crop: it is cured and immune until the end of the season. The sprayer treats a 3x3 area over 16 charges.

pages.title: Aphids
pages.text: Aphids halve a crop's growth and cut its yield to 80 %. They never appear on their own. Ladybugs clean them off within 2 blocks, and the scarecrow reduces how often they appear.
